3. To extend with restrictions or modifications any enactment in force in a State in India at the date of the notification to the State of Sikkim by public notification.
4. To remove any difficulty that arises in giving effect to the provisions of Article 371F, including making adaptations or modifications to other articles if necessary, within two years from the appointed day.
